decisions.reason: As an award-backed yogurt close to the core range, management would likely continue it and explain any weaker recent visibility as temporary or due to website presentation rather than product failure.
Because this cheese was publicly highlighted as a flagship for the firm's direction, sunk commitment and justification pressures make withdrawal very unlikely.
This semi-hard cheese sits within the established cheese business and, absent clear evidence of failure, management would tend to persist with it rather than admit the launch was not worthwhile.
As a spicy cheese line with several models, it likely involved meaningful launch effort and assortment commitment, so management would be more inclined to refine the line than remove it outright.
